description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractStreamingActor that handles streaming commands and responses using Akka actors. It manages source creation, batching, and timeout configurations for streaming data.

classes.name: AbstractStreamingActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor for streaming data in response to commands, parameterized by command type C and element type E.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Returns the class object of the command type processed by this actor.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Extracts the batch size / rate from a given command.

methods.name: getInitialTimeout
methods.description: Returns the initial timeout duration from the command.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the idle timeout duration from the command.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates the Akka Source of elements to be streamed based on the command.

methods.name: batchMessages
methods.description: Batches a list of elements into either a singleton or a list for streaming.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling: processes commands and logs unexpected messages.

methods.name: startStreaming
methods.description: Handles the start of streaming upon receiving a command, creating source references and sending them back.
